description: Paraphrased actual vacancies from employer/StepStone listings, manually labeled REVIEW as plausible adjacent positions that must not be auto-approved.

cases.title: IT Data & Integration Engineer (m/w/d)
requirements: Professional background in data analytics and automated ETL reporting
Advanced SQL and business intelligence tooling such as Power BI or Qlik
Experience with data integration middleware and enterprise data systems
Familiarity with encryption and data access controls
Relevant university qualification in computer science, statistics or mathematics
German language suitable for business negotiations and English communication
tasks: Develop integrated data architectures, analytics pipelines, and Lakehouse connectivity
Create business intelligence dashboards and automated reporting
Ensure data quality and secure data exchange between applications

cases.title: SW-Quality Engineer KPI Design (m/w/d)
requirements: Strong knowledge of software quality assurance within automotive development
Substantial implementation and assessment experience with Automotive SPICE
Advanced Python scripting for querying APIs and processing development data
Practical Power BI data modeling and dashboard design
Understanding of CI/CD, version control and traceability
Familiarity with SQL or NoSQL data stores
Experience introducing software quality KPIs and agile working methods
tasks: Design software quality KPI definitions aligned with Automotive SPICE
Extract engineering metrics via REST APIs and build Power BI dashboards
Analyze process maturity and report software quality risks
